name: Strah otrazhenija
source:
Aren't you tired of monotonous cycles? Every shift is the same, you can go crazy, right?
Our heroine is the only character who remembers every shift, but... She doesn't remember how she herself became part of this cycle...
You will learn another story of Lena, who has long gone crazy and no longer hoped for change, but one evening, a very suspicious bus arrived...
translation:
你不厌倦单调的循环吗？每个班次都一样，你会发疯的，对吧？
我们的女主角是唯一记得每一次转变的角色，但是……她不记得自己是如何成为这个循环的一部分……
你会了解到莉娜的另一个故事，她早已疯了，不再希望改变，但有一天晚上，一辆非常可疑的公共汽车来了……
